prompts: Use case: product-mockup. Square premium photorealistic laser-cut MDF product photograph. Reference images show the REAL Honda CIVIC FE 11th-generation Thai four-door sedan, side profile and official RS front. Reproduce this exact car's geometry in wood: long low straight hood, slim horizontal headlights, straight beltline, clean side panels, four doors, small triangular rear quarter window, long wheelbase, separate sedan trunk with tiny lip, slim angular taillights. Car occupies 75% width. Robust small wooden eyelet above rear trunk with realistic silver chain and split ring above to right. Fine MDF texture, tactile real thickness, high-end automotive workshop photography, softly blurred dark tool wall beyond. No other products.
